author: Cleo Abram
description:
Brain chips don't read your mind. They do something weirder... 
Subscribe for more optimistic science and tech stories!

This is Neuralink’s Next Gen R1 surgical robot. It’s one of several new ways scientists are now trying to combine the human brain with a computer, which sounds like science fiction because… it is! But not anymore. 

And you need to know about this right now, because human clinical trials are happening and this tech is moving fast.

Some people want to use it to make you superhuman. But I think most people aren’t seeing what’s really huge if true here. This story isn’t about how to make us more like machines

Instead, this might be one of the most cutting edge ways to keep us human.
